name: W System
description: Checks EU VAT, EORI, company registers and sanctions, and validates and builds EN 16931 e-invoices, for AI agents via a remote MCP server, REST API or x402 pay-per-call.

skills.name: Verify EU VAT
skills.description: Validates EU VAT numbers against VIES, with batch checks and flagged fallback to national sources when VIES is down.

skills.name: Verify EORI
skills.description: Checks EU and XI EORI numbers against the European Commission EOS service, singly or in batches of up to 100.

skills.name: Screen Sanctions
skills.description: Screens person and company names against the EU, UN, OFAC SDN and UK sanctions lists with fuzzy, transliteration-aware matching.

skills.name: KYB Check
skills.description: Combines VIES, an official business-register lookup and sanctions screening into one pass, review or fail verdict for a company.

skills.name: Validate E-Invoice
skills.description: Validates UBL, CII and ZUGFeRD or Factur-X invoices against EN 16931 and XRechnung rules, returning rule IDs and fix hints.

skills.name: E-Invoice Route
skills.description: Tells an agent how to e-invoice a company: VIES status, Peppol registration, participant id and the country's mandate.
